create.claim: Paste it. Seal it. Share it.
create.noscript: {name} encrypts content exclusively in your browser before it is sent anywhere. Without JavaScript there is nowhere for that to happen, so the editor cannot be shown.
create.heading: Share encrypted, without an account
create.lede: Text is encrypted in your browser. The server stores ciphertext only and knows neither the content nor the key.
create.passwordNote: The password never leaves your browser. Choose a strong passphrase — the link alone will not open this capsule.
create.passwordBlank: The password consists only of spaces. Enter a real password, or leave the field empty for no password.
create.encryptingLede: Generating keys and encrypting your content locally.
create.doneLede: Copy the link now. It is shown only once — the server does not store it.
view.title: Open capsule
view.noscript: {name} decrypts content exclusively in your browser. Without JavaScript there is nowhere for that to happen — the server does not know the key and cannot open the content for you.
manage.title: Manage capsule
manage.noscript: The delete secret is in the fragment of the address and is only turned into a capability inside your browser. Without JavaScript there is nowhere for that to happen.
manage.footer: Deleting is permanent and cannot be undone.
manage.lede: This page can delete the capsule but not open it: the delete link contains no decryption key.
manage.confirmLede: The capsule will be permanently removed. Anyone with the share link will no longer be able to open it.
manage.warningDetail: The ciphertext is deleted immediately from the database.
manage.deletingLede: Contacting the server to remove the capsule.
manage.deletedLede: The capsule has been permanently deleted.
manage.unavailableLede: This capsule does not exist, has already been deleted, or the link is incomplete.
report.noscript: The report form needs JavaScript. You can also reach the operator at the address given in the site notice.
report.idOnly: Send the paste id only, never the full link.
report.keyAfter: in a link is the decryption key. This form strips it before sending and refuses text that contains one. Do not include it in screenshots either.
report.lede: Content on this service is encrypted; the operator cannot read it and does not need to. A report lets the operator block or remove the capsule by its id.
report.pasteNote: The part after # is removed before sending.
report.contactNote: Only if you want to hear back.
report.sentLede: Thank you. The operator reviews reports and can block or remove a capsule without decrypting it.
report.disabledLede: This instance does not accept reports through this form. Please use the address given in the site notice.
report.footer: Reports are handled without decrypting anything.
shell.languageNextPage: The language applies from the next page on.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
error.rateLimitedFor#one: Too many requests. Try again in {count} second.
error.rateLimitedFor#other: Too many requests. Try again in {count} seconds.
error.payloadTooLarge: The capsule is larger than this server accepts.
error.expiryTooLong: This server does not keep capsules that long. Choose a shorter expiry.
error.permanentNotAllowed: This server does not keep capsules without expiry. Choose an expiry.
error.creationClosed: This server does not accept new capsules from this page.
error.server: The server could not process the request. Please try again later.
link.noKey: The link is incomplete — no key found.
link.unreadable: The key in the link could not be read.
item.filePreviewNote: Files are never previewed. It was decrypted in your browser and is saved exactly as the sender added it.
create.sizeOver: {size} of {max} — over the limit by {over}. Remove or shrink an item to continue.
create.dropAnywhere: Drop a file here, or anywhere on this form
create.tooManyItems: A capsule holds at most {max} items.
view.openingLede: The key is in the fragment of this address and does not leave your browser.
view.decryptingLede: Decrypting in your browser. The server cannot read this content.
view.burnedLede: This capsule was set to delete after its first retrieval and has already been opened. The content is no longer available.
view.burnWarning: This capsule can only be opened once
view.burnWarningLede: The sender chose to delete this capsule after its first retrieval. Opening it now will permanently remove it from the server.
view.burnWarningDetail: After opening, the content will no longer be available — not for you, not for anyone else.
view.passwordLede: The sender protected this capsule with a password. Enter it below to decrypt the content. The password is never sent to the server.
view.wrongPassword: Wrong password, or the capsule is no longer available.
view.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
view.tooManyAttemptsFor#one: Too many attempts. Try again in {count} second.
view.tooManyAttemptsFor#other: Too many attempts. Try again in {count} seconds.
view.unavailableLede: This capsule does not exist, has expired, or the link is incomplete.
view.decryptFailed: Decryption failed. The content may have been modified or the key is wrong.
view.invalidCapsule: The capsule could not be read. Its content is damaged or in a format this page does not understand.
report.error.noId: Enter a share link or a 22-character paste id.
report.error.containsKey: The description or contact contains a link with its key (the part after #). Remove the key and send again — the id in the first field is enough.
report.error.rateLimited: Too many reports from your network. Please try again later.
report.error.rejected: The report was not accepted. The description and contact must not be too long, contain control characters or a link with its key (the part after #).
report.error.invalidId: The report was not accepted: this is not a valid paste id.
report.error.tooLarge: The report is too long. Please shorten the description or the contact.
report.error.server: The report could not be sent because of a server error. Please try again later.
report.error.generic: The report could not be sent. Please try again later.
report.error.network: The report could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
